# `react/DensityControls`

Two steppers and a reset, painted from the theme and named from the label channel. The
control never clamps on its own: it hands the value to `clampDensityTuning`, which is where the
bounds live.

## Example

```ts
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_CONTROL_LABELS, type DensityControlLabels } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export const labels: DensityControlLabels = { ...DEFAULT_DENSITY_CONTROL_LABELS, reset: 'padrão' };
```

## `DensityControlsProps`

Derived from the interface and from the destructuring in the component, so a default that
changes in the code changes here.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tuning` | `DensityTuning` | yes | — |
| `onChange` | `(tuning: DensityTuning) => void` | yes | — |
| `labels` | `DensityControlLabels \| undefined` | no | `DEFAULT_DENSITY_CONTROL_LABELS` |
| `theme` | `WorkspaceTheme \| undefined` | no | `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_THEME` |
| `testIdPrefix` | `string \| undefined` | no | `'density'` |
